verdict.rationale: Paychex's own marketing says time tracking can be added 'without switching systems, moving data' and 'maximize[s] payroll accuracy'. Its payroll page also mentions fixing missing punches before the pay cycle. Together these imply time punches feed payroll natively, but there is no explicit documentation of hourly entries or overtime flowing automatically into the payroll run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of time-to-payroll sync, overtime calculation and transfer into payroll, hands-on or independent corroboration.
